title: Replies at any depth
text: Reply to any comment, however deep. Indentation stops at maxIndent and deeper replies say who they answer, so threads stay readable on phones.

title: Mentions everywhere
text: Every comment and reply box is a Mention Input: @ suggests people from your directory or from the discussion itself.

title: Character count that blocks
text: Set maxLength and every box shows a counter; posting over the limit is blocked and the error is announced.

title: Delete without breaking threads
text: An inline confirmation, then a 'This comment was deleted' placeholder when replies exist, or removal when they do not.

title: Who and when
text: Author, avatar, and a relative time on every comment, with the absolute date in a <time> element, time-zone and holiday aware.

title: Big threads stay light
text: Deep threads start collapsed, top-level comments and replies page in with Show more, and replies can load lazily from your server.
